Strategy: Apply the thirty-to-forty-five sweet band only when the item is at least fifty, so the band guides larger items while smaller ones use Best Fit. It may help by focusing the band where leftovers are bigger, but may fail if smaller items would also benefit from the band.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if item >= 50 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) for r in bins]
```
